name: Garrett

origin.summary: Honors Marine Captain Garrett 'Tubes' Lawton, 31, killed by an improvised explosive device in Herat Province, Afghanistan, on August 4, 2008. Three rounds of high-volume squats, ring handstand push-ups, and L-pull-ups — gymnastics density few Heroes match.

description: Three rounds of high-rep air squats followed by ring handstand push-ups and l-pull-ups — a squat-heavy round leading into two strict gymnastics movements.
source_notes: crossfit.com/benchmark/garrett (official CrossFit Hero WOD page), retrieved 2026-07-09
